response.original_title: Toba, The Volcano that Changed the World
response.overview: Through a series of five successive mega eruptions, around 70,000 years ago, the Toba volcano pushed humanity to its limits, causing a drastic decline in biodiversity and the human population on earth. But, this cataclysm would have at the same time pushed the survivors to evolve, forcing them to develop new behaviors essential to their survival.
